keys.statement: Acetic acid and water form no azeotrope but are close-boiling, so heterogeneous azeotropic distillation is used; with n-butyl acetate as entrainer a cited study cut annual cost by 55% against plain distillation, and dilute feeds often add a preconcentrator column.

decisions.mechanism: The entrainer carries water overhead as a heterogeneous azeotrope.
decisions.operation: Heterogeneous azeotropic distillation with an ester entrainer.

keys.statement: For aqueous solvent mixtures with several azeotropes, hybrid extractive-heterogeneous azeotropic distillation uses the water already present as entrainer, so no new solvent or azeotrope is added.

decisions.obstacle: Several azeotropes in a solvent waste.
decisions.mechanism: Water acts as extractive agent and forms separable heterogeneous azeotropes.
